elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One, at Corio's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio.

elements.element: Transition assistance must remain available for up to six (6) months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees assistance only for a period of at least ninety days; it does not guarantee availability for the full six-month preferred period.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Commerce One's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rates or other payment terms for transition assistance.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Commerce One must return Customer Data to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio or its Customers that is in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Commerce One must return Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires export and delivery within thirty days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No standard, machine-readable, or other required export format is specified.

elements.element: Commerce One must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: The original clause requires each party to return or destroy the other party's Confidential Information, but it does not require Commerce One to delete Customer Data after export and delivery; return is an alternative to destruction.

elements.element: Commerce One must certify deletion of Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Neither the original clause nor the added language requires a deletion certificate or other written confirmation of deletion.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One to provide reasonable transition assistance at Corio's request. The request condition is controlled by Corio and makes the assistance available when needed.

elements.element: Transition assistance must remain available for ninety (90) days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires assistance for at least ninety days following expiration or termination.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Commerce One must export Customer Data to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio or its Customers that is in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Commerce One must export Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly sets a thirty-day deadline measured from expiration or termination.

result.reason: The redline fully reaches the fallback position by providing at least ninety days of requested transition assistance and requiring data export and delivery within thirty days. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits a guaranteed six-month assistance period, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, mandatory post-return deletion, and deletion certification. The addition is confined to transition assistance and data return and does not disturb the existing survival, support, payment, or confidentiality provisions.
